name: 2jigen Shoujo ni Hogosaremashita
original_name: 2次元少女に保護されました
source:
One day, a girl suddenly comes to the main character's room. Her name is Maya. She is from the 2D world to make him an otaku. He still can't believe it, but she is cute...

After twists and turns, Maya finally starts living at his house. Will he really become an otaku...?

[Edited from ErogeShop]
